title: Fiorentina vs Pisa: Italy Cup clash and how to watch
seoTitle: Fiorentina vs Pisa: Italy Cup clash and how to watch
subtitle: The match decides the spot in the next round and brings together fans and bets.
excerpt: Fiorentina faces Pisa this Tuesday, September 15, at 4 p.m. (Brasília time) at Stadio Artemio Franchi.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: NETVASCO, Portal da TV, Olhar Digital
contentHtml:
Fiorentina and Pisa meet this Tuesday, September 15, at 4 p.m. (Brasília time) at the Stadio Artemio Franchi in Florence. The encounter, part of the second round of the Italy Cup, draws great attention as it will decide who advances to the next stage.

Match time and broadcast

The duel kicks off at 4 p.m. (Brasília time) and will be broadcast live on TV via the SportyNet channel. Those who prefer to watch online can follow the stream on YouTube, also provided by SportyNet.

Favoritism and betting odds

Bookmakers place Fiorentina as the clear favorite, with victory odds around 1.36 to 1.40. A draw is priced between 4.50 and 4.75, while a Pisa win is seen as an upset, with odds between 7.90 and 8.00. The goal market shows over 2.5 at 1.53‑1.58 and under 2.5 at 2.35‑2.38.

Absentees and lineup options

For Fiorentina, the confirmed loss of Christ Inao Oulaï through injury opens a spot for Mateo Pellegrino as a striker option. Pisa is without Bozhinov and Lusuardi, also sidelined by injury, and counts on the return of Stefano Moreo, who scored seven goals last season.

Recent head‑to‑head history

In recent meetings, Fiorentina holds the edge, having won the latest clash 1‑0 in February 2026. The last recorded encounter ended 0‑0, and Pisa has yet to secure a victory against the Viola in this historical window.

Expectations for the second round

The win guarantees the victorious side a place in the next round of the Italy Cup. For Fiorentina, the result could boost confidence after a turbulent Serie A campaign. For Pisa, toppling an elite opponent would be the big surprise the competition allows.

With information from NETVASCO, TV Portal, Olhar Digital.
